subject: general
question: Which river did Alexander first cross to invade India in 326 BC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indus.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Alexander occupied India in 326 B.C., crossing the **Indus River** on his way to Taxila.
 
• The Indus is **the most important supplier of water resources to the Punjab and Sindh plains.**
 
• It forms the backbone of agriculture and **food production in Pakistan. **
 
• The river is mainly critical since rainfall is meager in the l**ower Indus valley.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a2f5204c826e315a4737fe890fccfbf9f67685c70be7babb52b239be129bdcc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chenab River, is the river of the Indian subcontinent in **northwestern India and northeastern and eastern Pakistan**.
 
• The Sutlej River is **the longest of the five rivers that flow through the historic crossroads region of Punjab in northern India and Pakistan**.​ 
 
• Jhelum River at **Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India**.
